notes: Seven web searches ran, none refused. dankoh.com is a domain-for-sale page, not his campaign site; no campaign issues page was found. Reading Post profile (thereadingpost.com/?p=37927) returned 403 and could not be read. Coverage shows pro-AI super political action committee spending (about $99,108 reported by a tracker) supporting Koh and a Guardrails Alliance banner attacking him as funded by AI billionaires; these are about money, not his statements, and were left out. A page koh-opposition-hub.pages.dev appeared in results but is partisan opposition material and was not used. No sign he is a sponsor of the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act (he is not a sitting member). Search coverage of his AI views was thin, so the search may be incomplete.
